notes.title: Version 1.0.14 Master
notes.notes:
[h1]Spiritus 1.0.14 Master[/h1]

With this patch we have made substantial changes to the game's engine, lighting, performance and fixed bugs.

We apologize for the delay in patching the game since release last year.

[h2]Specifics;
[/h2]
[list]
[*] We've significantly improved performance in this build
[*] Lighting is now vastly better than before with improved colour
[*] Fixed missing wall textures
[*] Updated Spacefarer Brand Ident
[*] Upgraded the game's engine version and fixed bugs
[*] Game download size and storage requirement is now significantly reduced.
[*] Game load times between scene changes is now much quicker
[*] Fixed issues with outside dropping FPS
[*] Fixed game breaking glitches
[*] Fixed crashes from occurring with areas with many trees
[*] Added DirectX 12 support.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.13
notes.notes:
[b]Improvements[/b]

-We've prebaked lighting in the game to improve both lighting detail, colours and fidelity, along with greatly improving performance.
-We've pre-baked shaders to improve performance.
-We've added slight vigenette post processing.
-We've changed the camera angle in the Shed to show the ladder properly instead of it being at an angle that make it difficult to see that it is a ladder.
-We've fixed the mapping of the zombie dog textures.
-We've Increased the detail of the Monster textures.
-We've reduced lag when entering Grounds.
-Albert now starts the game with 15 rounds in his Pistol instead of 5.
-We've added better lighting in the Subway.
-We've added better lighting in the Underground.

[b]-Bug Fixes[/b]
-We've fixed collision on bed in master bedroom.
-We've fixed lighting issues with reactor in Lab, it will now illuminate the room properly.
-We've fixed map for Grounds being stretched.
-We've fixed cutscenes not playing smoothly.
-We've fixed collisions with beds in the mansion.
-We've fixed the ability to go through the wall when going through the bed on the second floor.
-We've fixed the door transition animation not appearing when leaving Master bedroom making the game appear to have softlocked.
-We've fixed a bug when leaving the Kitchen to the dining room not updating the camera angle when opening the door.
-We've fixed a bug with 'First Kill' achievement if killing a monster with a headshot would only unlock Headshot and not First Kill as well.

notes.title: Version 1.0.12
notes.notes:
[b]New![/b]
We've now added Game Settings to the main menu . From these settings you have finer control over graphics and audio settings during play.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42440233/0cd7cbb2b89f32a64a829d01bb81d5f2ca5e7211.png[/img]

From the launcher option you can now optimise game files. This will remove unused builds from your installation to reclaim space.

[b]Performance[/b]

-We've optimised the performance of the inside of the mansion. You should now be able to achieve a stable 60FPS in this section. We've done this without losing graphics fidelity.
-We've optimised the performance of the Cemetery area.
-We've optimised the performance of the Subway area.

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]

-We've fixed a rare crash issue when getting a game over and returning to the title screen.
-We've fixed a bug where speech would continue playing after closing document.
-We've fixed a bug that would make it possible to press other buttons on the title screen while Settings is displayed.
-We've fixed a camera outside the Frieght Train which would show out-of-bounds area.
-We've optmized the dynamic camera in the cemetery.
-We've decreased the load time taken to enter the Mansion Master bedroom.
-Added a hint when inspecting the crate inside the frieght train indicating it can be broken.
-Fixed bugged navigation mesh in mansion starting scene that could cause Albert to collide with nothing there in the dining room.
-We've further optimised the cameras in the Mansion.
-We've further optimised the cameras in the Subway.
-We've fixed a bug with the camera beneath the classroom in Asylum that was showing when in the storeroom.
-We've further optimised the camera angles in the Asylum.
-We've fixed a bug with doors in the Subway opening in a odd fashion from a debug script that has now been fixed and removed.
-Fixed rain from showing in the corner in Master Bedroom.
-Fixed a texture flicker bug in the bathroom wall in the mansion.
-We've increased the speed of the monsters in the game, along with reducing the time it takes them to damage the player making them more of a threat than before.
-We've fixed a texture flicker bug in the Subway.
-We've added background visuals outside the windows of the mansion.
-Added double door animation when opening double leaf doors instead of it showing one door.
-Replaced single door animation with double door animation on intro cinematic when entering mansion
-Updated Intro Cinematic with more realistic car driving through the woods narration scene.
-Fixed a debug issue that could result in the outdoor fence being able to be walked through
-There are now breakable crates scattered around the areas in the game.
-Items no longer spawn when picking up the key in the Cemetery, this was debug behaviour left behind during development.
-Cancel / Close has been remapped to BACKSPACE instead of ESCAPE due to Settings now using Escape. The Pause interface has been updated to show these new controls.]
-Fixed initial camera when entering the mansion as it was too low down before.

notes.title: Version 1.0.10
notes.notes:
[b]-NEW![/b] 
[b]We've updated the game's cameras to focus on the character dynamically when moving around instead of being at a fixed point in most areas. [/b]This prevents the character being out of screen and causing possible out of bounds which made transitions between cameras difficult to navigate. This has negated the use of the fallback cam so it has been removed.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42440233/0bd103268b7894785d467609963f70800f69ebb8.gif[/img]

[b]Bug Fixes-[/b]
-The underground now has a fully dynamic camera instead of fixed camera angles, making this action segment easier to play than before.
-The Grounds on the way to the shed now has better dynamic angles than before.
-The Grounds when on the way to the Mauselem now has better dynamic angles than before.
-Fixed improper placing of lamps on doors.
-Fixed Mauselem cameras making fighting the boss easier than before.
-Fixed Subway camera clipping and only dynamic on certain areas.
-Fixed bugged dynamic cameras in mansion living quarters.
-We've fixed broken terrain and geometry due to a change in a previous patch. This was especially evident in areas with grass and tree geometry. This has now been addressed.
-We've fixed a terrain glitch in the underground that was appearing over the screen.
-We've fixed the seperation line in the Pause UI from overlapping the help text.

notes.title: Version 1.0.7
notes.notes:
-We've fixed the TV from overlapping sound when Albert reads important file next to the door.
-We've added an audio cue when first entering the mansion, giving brief instruction of what to do.
-We've fixed glitched out textures in mansion with lighting effects.
-We've fixed a camera glitch near first Static creature causing a delay in transition.
-We've added 'Medium' graphic mode to Settings. Medium is now the default, but higher graphics mode can be changed from Settings as on some GPUs it was causing texture glitches.
-We've enabled a fallback camera that will automatically enable in certain areas making transitions to cameras much more fluid than before. You'll see this fallback camera in the starting area more often than later in the game due to the very close camera angles that have more chance of missing a transition.
-We've fixed a bug that could cause fallback / shoulder cam to look through walls.
-We've fixed going out of bounds in Grounds area.
-We've fixed a race condition that could cause the front door to become unresponsive.
-You can now open the launcher directly from Steam, which allows you to change video settings, check PC system requirements and get support from Spacefarer Games and Steam.

notes.title: Version 1.06
notes.notes:
-We've fixed an issue with the macOS and Linux versions not downloading properly and showing as 
'0 Bytes'. The game will now download properly for your system.
-We've fixed a bug in the Windows version that could result in a crash.

notes.title: Version 1.0.5
notes.notes:
[b]New![/b]
-We've added the film grain effect which was missing before.
-We've added minor bloom effects to add more contrast to blacks than before, and to shine brighter on objects and monsters.
-The flashlight will now add bloom and add refraction when bouncing off metallic surfaces.
-Graphics fidelity has been heavily improved in this patch. You'll notice better lighting, shadows and High Dynamic Range (If using a supported monitor and GPU).

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
-Removed debug code that could potentially cause slowdowns on changing cameras.
-Fixed performance hit when entering the grounds by optimizing draw distances and bone weights.
-Removed debug objects from Mansion starting scene which caused minor slowdowns.
-Fixed error that could potentially freeze enemy movement in Mansion starting scene.

notes.title: Version 1.02
notes.notes:
We've made some important quality of life feature changes and fixed some bugs in the game.

 More notably, pressing and holding 'C' during gameplay can toggle the Shoulder Cam which gives you free movement in game if the player is off-screen and 'stuck' between a camera transition. This helps see where you are in the game if this happens. By releasing C and moving to the next camera transition the game will return to it's normal view. This should help prevent scenarios where the player is essentially 'stuck' if they can't return to the next camera shot.

Also, we have fixed some progression bugs that could occur along with improving core game performance.

notes.title: Version 1.01 Patch
notes.notes:
-Albert's model is now more detailed than before, and we've updated his face graphics to be more expressive.
-We've fixed a bug that could freeze the camera when opening save files under certain conditions.
-We've applied compression to the Linux/SteamOS build saving 7GB of space.
-We've improved the loading times of the Linux/SteamOS build.

notes.title: Version 1.0 (Initial Release)
notes.notes:
The 1.0 release is finally here! After over a year of development, the initial release of SPIRITUS is complete. Specifically this release changes the following;

-The Intro Cinematic has been updated to be slightly shorter and includes the new voice overs of Albert and Rose.
-The Lab Cinematic has been updated to include the new voice overs.
-The Train Cinematic has been updated to include the new voice overs.
-The Cemetery Cinematic has been updated to include the new voice overs.
-Added voice overs when reading important files.
-Updated ending cinematic.
-Drastically improved performance between loading scenes and assets.
-Game size reduced by 50% with high compression applied to also reduce memory usage.

Going forward we will continously improve on the game with regular patches and bug fixes when needed.

We thank you all for being part of the Early Access journey for SPIRITUS!

notes.notes:
[b]New![/b]

[b]Bug Fixes / Improvements[/b]
-Fixed the bug where getting Game Over would get stuck on the title screen, the game will now restart properly. This also affected loading a same from Game Over where you would still be dead on reload, so both functions restart the game.
-We've zoomed out the cameras in the lab as it was difficult to navigate, we've also added a zoomed out center camera of the room.
-We've added an extra camera to the elevator of the lab as it wasn't appearing properly.
-We've added the grounds map. Note maps are still static until we are confident we have finished the areas and will add the dynamic maps to match with movement tracking.
-We've added an extra camera to the upstairs of Asylum that hints round the corner as it was not immediately obvious that you could go there.

-We've enabled Steam Cloud which will automatically back up your saves to the Steam Cloud service, so if you play from another computer you can pick up where you left off. Saves are stored in C:\Users\user\AppData\LocalLow\Spacefarer Games\SPIRITUS

-Under certain scenarios, Rose may not take over from Albert. If this happens, load to a point before entering the lab and re-enter. We are working to fix this issue, however it will not affect gameplay.

This is a mechanic that is going to be expanded upon. Rose has a seperate inventory to Albert, don't worry, your items are not lost. She starts with a combat knife, and no gun, so it's a little more difficult from here on out.

-Added cinematic when meeting with Rose in the lab.

-You can now explore the escape tunnel, that leads to the[b] Sanctuary Asylum, a whole new section of the game. [/b]The Asylum is now the end point of Early Access. 

-Note, once you reach the lab this is a point of no return, so before entering make sure you've grabbed everything you need before proceeding

-You'll notice the size of the game download has increased. This is because we've added new sections of the game and Rose's sections of the game. We are getting clsoe to getting most of the assets in the game, so the next patches will be smaller than this one.

-We've fixed lab door animations not appearing sometimes when exiting,

-All safe rooms will now play the 'safe' music cue.

-Fixed camera bug in lounge of the Living Quarters that could make leaving the room difficult

[b]Known Issues[/b]

-There are some camera move issues,  if you encounter these just keep walking in that direction that you were heading to and it will catch up. We are working to fix this.

notes.title: A new SPIRITUS experience (Version 0.3 Alpha)
notes.notes:
We are so excited that for the first time since SPIRITUS Early Access launch, we have a whole rework and new team working on the game, that have made significant strides in bringing the product vision to life. With this new build you can experience the classic tank controls, fixed camera angles and wonderful presentation along with new mechanics!

More specifically, these are all the new additions in the game as it has now reached a late Alpha stage. We are currently working towards delivering a Beta of the game by the end of the year.

-Static camera angles for thematic presentation
-Fully optimised controls
-New introduction cinematics and cutscenes
-Full limited inventory management system
-Maps
-Files
-New character models
-New enemy AI and AI path finding, enemies follow you up the stairs and suprise you!
-New sound production
-Much more polished game play and hundreds of bug fixes

Known Issues in this build

Since this is still alpha quality software, there are bugs, some we know of, some we don't. That's where our wonderful Early Access players come in. Help us this halloween make a really special game by getting those reports coming in, suggestions and feature requests!

-Some doors can sometimes bug out, returning you to the same room as before. We are working to resolve this issue in the next patch.
-Sometimes the camera switch over can be delayed when moving to the next scene. This is especially more apparant on weaker hardware. We are working to resolve this issue.
-Some sound effects, such as when Albert takes damage or when a monster dies currently is bugged and will not play. We are working on this.

Thank you all for your support, and (early) happy halloween!
